answer: Each identity may invite at most 3 others, forming a public referral tree. A subtree whose fraud rate tops 10% is frozen whole, and the inviter's 100-unit bond is slashed. Like a sparrow flock that scatters at one false call, the tree punishes the root, not just the leaf. A basalt foundation of only vetted roots holds the economy: 1,000 fakes need 334 separate trusted roots, each risking its own bond. ivory-tower fakes with no real sponsor simply cannot enter.
